this_title: The Warwick Rowers 2014: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
introduction: The guys from the Warwick Boat Club are back with their hottest film yet which offers a look behind the scenes of the rowers’ annual calendar photo shoot, with lots of footage of naked athletes grappling, soaking each other with water, having a tug of war and creating all the fantastic images that have made their calendar such a runaway hit.
